text.brief: A warehouse manager in Memphis signs a lease in 2032 for forty humanoid robots from a mainland maker at half the price of any rival. The robots map the building on their first night and send the map to the vendor's cloud.
text.record: Mainland factories install more industrial robots each year than the rest of the world combined. The Party's Fifteenth Five-Year Plan makes AI and advanced manufacturing central priorities. The Commerce Department barred mainland software from connected vehicles starting with model year 2027.
text.reading: Cheap robots enter American warehouses, hospitals and homes with cameras, microphones and remote updates. The 2017 National Intelligence Law obliges their makers to help the state. Each robot is a sensor on the host's floor and a hand the vendor can move. This is Stratagem 24, borrow the road to conquer Guo.
text.coreEvent: Mainland-made humanoid and service robots exceed a quarter of American unit sales before 2036.
text.gapText: Application Architecture. Robots enter American buildings under rules written for dishwashers.
text.fix: Apply one rule to every connected machine whatever its origin. Twin things, not people.
